name: BADM 3720
title: The Legal and Ethical Environment of Business
description: (Also offered as BLAW 3175.) This course provides an introduction to law, ethics, and social responsibility, and the foundation for advanced business law electives. Students learn to evaluate the impact of the legal and regulatory system on business operations, consider the role and functioning of legal institutions, and apply legal rules such as the Uniform Commercial Code to anticipate and avoid liability. Students gain experience identifying and solving legal and ethical problems using analytical tools.
requirement_description: Open only to non-Business students of sophomore or higher status. May not be taken out of sequence after passing BADM/BLAW 3274, 3660, or BLAW 3277.
